diagram_previews.alt: The parabolas y = x^2 (blue) and y = x^2/2 (red) with common vertex V at the origin. Dashed rays from V pass through X(1,1) and Y(-3/2,9/4) on the blue parabola and continue to X'(2,2) and Y'(-3,9/2) on the red parabola, showing the dilation with factor 2.
